title: Define provider-neutral structured intelligence contracts
businessObjective: Establish provider-neutral, schema-valid intelligence inputs and outputs for bounded technical, operational, SEO, and commercial analysis.
technicalObjective: Define IntelligenceProvider request and response contracts for evidence references, likely-cause explanations, ranked hypotheses, intervention selection, confidence, provider identity, and deterministic failure results without implementing a provider.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
Codex, OpenAI API, local models, and other future providers must implement the same contract and cannot authorize an intervention.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema-valid requests reference prepared evidence and bounded task purpose, data classification, requested analysis, and allowed context.

Schema-valid responses explain likely causes, rank hypotheses, select an intervention, estimate confidence, cite evidence, identify the provider/model, and distinguish insufficient evidence from provider failure.
The finite contract is provider-neutral and gives IntelligenceProvider no scheduling, workflow, policy, authorization, execution, or audit authority.
Malformed or incomplete requests and responses fail deterministic validation.
Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the ai-analysis branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.
